skill_name: Compare the differences between the effects of the pandemic on traditional retail and online retail
workflow: The effects of the pandemic on traditional retail and online retail have been markedly different. During the pandemic, many traditional retail stores have been closed or heavily restricted due to public health considerations. This has resulted in a dramatic drop in brick-and-mortar sales as consumers shifted to more online retailers for their shopping needs.
